title: Memory
summary: Short facts about the learner that the tutor and the examiner share across conversations.
description: What the examiner notices in a check-in should reach the tutor, and the other way round.

stories.want: the tutor and the examiner to remember what they learn about me, and to see and change it myself
stories.soThat: I do not repeat myself and nothing is kept that I do not want

requirements.text: A memory is one short fact of one of the kinds in `memory.kinds`.
A memory is at most `memory.max-chars` characters.
The tutor and the examiner both see the current memories in their prompt, at most the `memory.prompt-limit` most recently touched of each kind, and both can save, update and forget memories.
Whatever an agent saves is shown in the conversation as a Remembered line.
Settings lists memories by kind; the learner can edit one, forget one, add their own and forget everything.
With memory switched off, the agents neither read nor save memories.

values.description: The kinds a memory can be.
The longest a memory can be.
The most memories of one kind shown to an agent.
